title: DeleLuz · Phone directions
brief: Local-first BLE strip control: five 390×844 phone screens per direction, with distinct navigation and home layouts.

artboards.title: Classic Tabs
artboards.tradeoff: Device roster and five icon tabs make tools discoverable; persistent tabs consume height.

artboards.title: Strip First
artboards.tradeoff: Target-first workspaces keep Last sent pinned; switching tools takes an extra step.

artboards.title: Quick Scenes
artboards.tradeoff: Scene tiles make repeat looks easy; fine controls live in separate bottom sheets.

artboards.title: Mode Studio
artboards.tradeoff: Timeline-first Home brings precise editing forward; static controls are an output override.

artboards.title: Light Remote
artboards.tradeoff: Home is a power dial with gesture and button dimming; device management is secondary.
